author: PoutyJinx
name: SinPurge
short: Purge recent messages from a specific user.
description: SIN Corporation moderation tool for Red-DiscordBot. Purge recent messages from a specific user across one or all channels, including voice-channel chats and banned or left users by ID or exact name.
install_msg: SIN Purge installed. Use `[p]sinpurge @user 1h`, `[p]sinpurge USER_ID 1h all`, or `/sinpurge`.
